summary: Native file inventory now admits canonical workspace roots against the harness's held-cwd filesystem identity, allowing macOS temporary-directory aliases without following substituted roots or ancestors during enumeration.

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; canonical roots are recorded in new native inventory observations.

compatibility.detail: No API or wire shape change. Workspace admission fails closed when the resolved directory does not match the native filesystem identity; enumeration retains component-by-component no-follow checks.

downtime.detail: Takes effect with the next daemon build and fresh native inventory observation.
